integrity: Analytic Fourier proof, exact conditions; supplementary finite checks cannot replace proof; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Circle Laplace-Beltrami generator, identical redundant scalar diffusion fields, fixed h>0, mathematical p-Ret transition; at r=1 a separate fair sign is required; neither arbitrary manifolds nor finite-time sampling improvement is claimed. Older general compact-group results are a priority risk.
title: A sharp driving-noise dimension threshold for circle p-Ret mixing and discrete Poisson solvability
